cand.title: Vivantia Homes is developing two INNSiDE by Meliá new-build projects in Punta Cana, scheduled for 2027, totaling 476 rooms and including meeting rooms.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: José Luis Romero Fernandez, Managing Director, and Josep Mialet, Country Manager, are verified on Vivantia’s official team page. They are commercially relevant executive/routing contacts, not verified accommodation buyers. Neither is publicly shown controlling an external hotel contract for these projects.
findings.futureEdition: No future event edition was identified in the reviewed sources for November 2026–May 2028. Meliá’s 2 December 2024 announcement targets hotel openings in 2027, not event dates. Timing is unresolved: Vivantia’s online FAQ gives March 2027 delivery for Oasis Lake, while a Vivantia-branded Oasis Lake II FAQ distributed by a broker gives September 2028 delivery and estimated construction start in September 2026. These refer to development milestones/phases, not a confirmed opening ceremony or accommodation requirement. September 2028 is outside the requested horizon.
findings.hotelProductFit: Conditional inference, not published demand: Wyndham Alltra Punta Cana could suit a separately funded, guestroom-led executive retreat, broker familiarization or training group requiring an all-inclusive Uvero Alto stay. Its published 620 rooms and 380 m² of meeting space, accommodating 300 conference or 200 banquet guests, support that product fit. They do not establish a need. A 600-person congress marketed for Oasis Lake II would exceed Alltra’s stated indoor conference capacity; no such congress booking was identified.
findings.venueCommitments: The announced developments are INNSiDE Punta Cana Downtown, originally 290 rooms in central Punta Cana, and INNSiDE Punta Cana Bay, originally 186 rooms at Arena Gorda Beach. Both were announced with meeting rooms under Meliá franchise branding. These are planned competing hotel facilities, not a confirmed venue contract for an identified event. No event host hotel or incumbent accommodation supplier was established.
findings.historicalRotation: Not applicable as an edition timeline: no recurring Vivantia event series or destination/host-hotel rotation was established. A November 2025 executive interview announced the launch of Oasis Bay II and Oasis Lake II for 1 December 2025. That past commercial launch is outside the horizon and is not evidence of annual recurrence or a completed hotel opening.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown/unconfirmed. No published external-hotel RFP, buyer brief, room block, procurement deadline, contracted lodging supplier or overflow requirement was identified for this development programme. Apartment purchase reservations and owner-use rules in the FAQs are not group lodging procurement. Any pre-opening employee, investor or broker accommodation need remains a hypothesis.
findings.organizationStructure: Vivantia Homes is a property developer, not an association, PCO or DMC. Meliá identifies the hotels as Caribbean franchise projects. Vivantia’s project materials describe a condo-hotel/aparthotel investment model with Meliá brand supervision and Aimbridge professional management. Developer, brand and operator roles must remain separate; external travel-buying responsibility is not published.
findings.competitiveLimitations: This is primarily additional competing supply, not 476 rooms of customer demand. The 476-room seed total reflects the original 290/186-room announcement. Developer materials now market Oasis Bay with 172 apartments and Oasis Lake II with 210 suites; final hotel inventory and phasing should not be assumed unchanged. Sponsored project coverage describes a planned Oasis Lake II congress/events centre of 1,500 m² for 600 people; those are facility specifications, not attendance or an operating-venue confirmation. No sourced compression, sellout, overflow or displaced-room evidence was found.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Keep outside the qualified events pipeline pending a real demand brief. Approach Josep Mialet to identify who handles external project-team travel and José Luis Romero Fernandez for executive sponsorship/routing. Ask first whether any November 2026–May 2028 multi-night meeting, broker visit or training stay requires an external hotel, then obtain actual dates, peak rooms, budget, meeting setup and decision-maker. Reconcile the 2027 announcement with the phase-specific September 2028 delivery document. Present a tailored Alltra all-inclusive proposal only if a guestroom-led requirement is confirmed; do not assume overflow or send a speculative 476-room event bid.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: No current event edition exists in the reviewed evidence to classify as accessible or committed elsewhere. The INNSiDE development/brand relationship is established, but it is not proof that a separate employee or launch-event room block has been committed to those hotels. External accommodation sourcing remains unconfirmed, not open.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: relationship development may uncover a discrete pre-opening residential meeting or incentive requirement, but neither recurrence nor contestable hotel demand is verified. After opening, the developments’ own rooms and meeting facilities create a competitive limitation. A shared Aimbridge management connection, using the supplied Alltra context and Vivantia’s published operator statement, is a possible introduction route only; no shared procurement arrangement is established.

Official Alltra meetings page: 620 rooms; 380 m²; three event facilities; 300 conference/200 banquet capacity; all-inclusive Uvero Alto positioning.

Final Bay/Bávaro identity, hotel rental inventory and relationship between the originally announced 186 rooms and current residential project/phasing descriptions.
